components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's own positive action (e.g. confirm a booking). Pill, KU green.

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-sans, Anuphan, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ku, #0e7a4b); color: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-ku-hover, #0a6340); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-ku-hover, #0a6340); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ku, #0e7a4b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Google (Neutral) Button
components.description: The only ink-filled action: signing in through Google is neutral and external, so it does not claim the green accent. Large size (54px) with the Google 'G' on a white disc.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { font-family: var(--font-sans, Anuphan, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 54px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); color: #fff; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ink-disc { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: #232326; } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ku, #0e7a4b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ink:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. White fill, 1px hairline, ink text; hover washes to canvas.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font-family: var(--font-sans, Anuphan, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e3e5e0); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-canvas, #f4f4f1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ku, #0e7a4b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-plate { font-family: var(--font-sans, Anuphan, sans-serif); width: 240px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e3e5e0); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); } .ds-plate-code { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-plate-name { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5a5f5b); } .ds-plate-foot { margin-top: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-chip--free { background: var(--color-ku-soft, #e9f4ee); color: var(--color-ku, #0e7a4b); } .ds-chip--free .ds-chip-dot { background: var(--color-ku, #0e7a4b); } .ds-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; } .ds-tile--s { background: var(--color-ku, #0e7a4b); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Room status. Amber-ink text on amber-soft (the raw amber measures 3.31:1 and fails 4.5:1, so text uses the darker ink). Three states: available (green), busy (amber), full (canvas + hairline so the pill survives on white).
components.html: ว่างใช้งานถึง 15:30เต็ม
components.css: .ds-chips { font-family: var(--font-sans, Anuphan, sans-serif); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-chip--free { background: var(--color-ku-soft, #e9f4ee); color: var(--color-ku, #0e7a4b); } .ds-chip--free .ds-dot { background: var(--color-ku, #0e7a4b); } .ds-chip--busy { background: var(--color-amber-soft, #fcf3e3); color: var(--color-amber-ink, #8a5a12); } .ds-chip--busy .ds-dot { background: var(--color-amber, #b7791f); } .ds-chip--full { background: var(--color-canvas, #f4f4f1); color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5a5f5b); border-color: var(--color-border, #e3e5e0); } .ds-chip--full .ds-dot { background: var(--color-ink-muted, #5a5f5b); }

narrative.overview:
This is the room-booking desk of a faculty building, rendered as the wall of nameplates beside the door. Every room is a physical plate: a short code, a name, and an honest status chip. The login screen is that wall; the admin shell is the same wall's back office. The system's job is to make "which room, which hour, is it free?" answerable at a glance, in Thai, without decoration competing with the data.

The mood is flat and legible. Surfaces are warm paper (#f4f4f1) with white plates pinned on top, separated by 1px hairlines rather than shadows. KU green is the single accent and it means one thing — available, and the system's own action. Everything else is ink on paper. Generous radii keep the wall from feeling like paperwork; the absence of shadow keeps it from feeling like a product tour.

Density is calm but not sparse: plates sit on a 12px grid, navigation items on a 38px pitch, and the type scale does the ranking work. Thai is the primary language, so sizes run a step larger than a Latin-only equivalent and tracking stays conservative — negative tracking is reserved for display sizes where it tightens without clipping stacked tone marks.
keyCharacteristics: Flat: 1px borders and tonal fills only; there is no shadow anywhere in the system.
One accent: KU green marks availability and the primary action; amber is reserved for "busy"; blue and violet exist only to classify room types.
Plates, not cards: room status is a nameplate with a code, a name, and a chip.
Thai-first sizing: labels stay at 12px minimum, body at 16px, display at 68px desktop.
Calm motion: a single authored transition (the sidebar drawer), 300ms, and disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The No-Second-Accent Rule
rules.body: KU green is the only accent. If a new element needs emphasis, it uses weight, size, or ink — not a new hue. Blue and violet are category colors, not accents, and never appear outside a room-type tile.

rules.name: The Named-Not-Shaded Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a colour whose meaning is only "looks nice here". Every hue in this system already means something: green = available, amber = busy, blue = G, violet = P, red = error.

rules.name: The ±0.02 Rule
rules.body: Tracking is normal to −0.02em for everything at body size or below. Negative tracking is only used at title size (−0.02em) and larger (−0.03em). Thai stacks tone marks above ascenders; over-tightening at small sizes clips them.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No element sits above a heading as an eyebrow, overline, or kicker. Headings open their own section.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and in every state. Hover changes colour, not elevation. If something needs to feel "raised", it gets a 1px border and a white fill.

rules.name: The Scrim-Is-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The only overlay in the system is the drawer scrim. It darkens; it never blurs or shadows.

dos: Do keep depth flat: separate with a 1px #e3e5e0 border and tonal fill, never a shadow.
Do keep KU green (#0e7a4b) for availability and the system's own primary action, and amber (#b7791f / text #8a5a12) only for "busy".
Do switch on tabular-nums for anything a person compares down a column (room codes, service hours).
Do keep labels at 12px or larger and body at 16px — Thai needs the extra room.
Do give a plate a code, a name, and a status chip; that trio is what makes it a plate.
Do label representative data as representative (e.g. ตัวอย่างข้อมูล · สถานะจริงแสดงหลังเข้าสู่ระบบ).
donts: Don't add a shadow, blur, or elevation on hover — including on the drawer. The only overlay is the flat drawer scrim.
Don't introduce a second accent colour. Blue and violet are room-type categories, not accents.
Don't put a kicker, eyebrow, or overline above a heading.
Don't tighten tracking below −0.02em at body size or smaller; Thai tone marks clip.
Don't use an emoji or an icon font as an icon; icons are authored SVG at 1.8 stroke.
Don't put the large ink (neutral) treatment on a primary action — it is reserved for the Google sign-in button.
Don't use canvas (#f4f4f1) as a chip fill without a border on a white surface; the pill disappears.
